hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: This Privacy Policy explains how Engines Market collects, uses, stores, protects, and shares your personal data when you use our platform. It also explains your rights under UK data protection law.

items.title: Who we are (Data Controller)
items.description: Engines Market is a trading name of PRESTIGE AUTO ENGINEERING LTD , a private limited company registered in England and Wales.

blocks.text: Unit A5 Windsor Road Commercial Estate, Ramsden Heath, Billericay, United Kingdom, CM11 1QE
We act as a data controller for the personal data you provide to us when you use our Platform. This means we decide how and why your data is processed, and we are responsible for protecting it.

Our role is limited to providing a price comparison and lead generation service. We do not sell, fit, or warranty engines. When we introduce you to a supplier, that supplier becomes an independent data controller for the personal data you share with them directly or that we share with them on your behalf. You should read each supplier's own privacy policy before engaging their services.

items.title: The personal data we collect
items.description: We collect different categories of personal data depending on how you interact with our Platform.

blocks.text: When you submit an engine replacement quote request, we collect:

rows: To address you correctly and match quotes
To send quotes and allow suppliers to contact you
Registration number (looked up via DVLA API), make, model, engine code, fuel type, year, mileage
To identify the correct engine and provide accurate quotes
Description of the engine problem (e.g., “timing chain rattle”, “blue smoke”)
To help suppliers diagnose and quote accurately
Messages you send to our support team (via form, email, WhatsApp, or phone)
To respond to your queries and improve our service

blocks.text: If you contact us by phone, we may record the call for training, quality control, and security purposes. You will be informed of any recording at the beginning of the call.
When you visit our Platform, we automatically collect certain technical data:

rows: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device type
Pages visited, time spent, clicks, scroll depth, referral source
Approximate geographic location derived from IP address (city/region level only)

blocks.text: We do not collect sensitive “special category” data (e.g., health, race, political opinions, biometric data) or financial payment details. Any such data shared directly with a supplier is governed by that supplier's own privacy policy.

items: Payment card or bank account information
Driving licence or passport numbers
Any special category data (as defined under UK GDPR Article 9)
Information about children (our services are for adults only, aged 18+)

items.title: How we collect your personal data

rows: You provide data by filling in our quote request form, contacting us via email, phone, WhatsApp, or the contact form.
As you browse our Platform, we automatically collect technical data via cookies and server logs. See our Cookie Policy for details.
We may receive data from DVLA (via registration lookup API) to identify your vehicle. We do not buy or receive marketing lists from third parties.

items.title: How we use your personal data (lawful bases)
items.description: Under UK GDPR, we must have a lawful basis for each processing activity. We rely on four lawful bases:

items: Contract — processing necessary to provide the service you requested.
Legitimate interests — processing that is necessary for our legitimate business interests, provided your rights do not override those interests.
Legal obligation — processing required to comply with the law (e.g., tax, fraud prevention).
Consent — where you have given explicit permission (e.g., for non-essential cookies).

rows: To provide you with engine replacement quotes
Processing is necessary to perform our contract with you — we cannot provide quotes without sharing your data with suppliers.
To match your enquiry with relevant suppliers
To manage our supplier network (onboarding, monitoring)
We have a legitimate interest in maintaining a high-quality supplier network. This does not override your rights because we use aggregated or anonymised data where possible.
To improve our Platform (analytics, A/B testing)
We have a legitimate interest in understanding how users interact with our Platform to improve performance. We use pseudonymised data where possible.
Protecting our business and users from security threats is a legitimate interest.
We may be required to retain or disclose data by law.
These are part of the service you requested. You cannot opt out of service emails because they are necessary to deliver the service.

blocks.text: Important note on Legitimate Interests: We have conducted a Legitimate Interests Assessment (LIA) for each purpose listed above. Our interests do not override your rights because we limit data sharing to what is necessary, we retain data only as long as required, and you can object at any time (see Section 6 — Your rights).

items.title: How we share your personal data

blocks.text: When you submit a quote request, we share your personal data with our network of vetted UK engine suppliers. This is the fundamental purpose of our service.
What we share: Your name, email address, phone number, postcode, vehicle registration, make, model, engine code, mileage, and your description of the engine problem.

rows: A maximum of 10 suppliers can access your lead. Once 10 suppliers have viewed or quoted on your request, the lead is automatically closed and no further suppliers can access your data.

Every supplier signs a binding DSA before joining our network. The DSA requires suppliers to: (i) act as an independent data controller; (ii) use your data only to provide a quote for the specific engine you requested; (iii) not add your data to any marketing database; (iv) not share your data with any third party; (v) indemnify us against any fines or claims resulting from their misuse of your data.
Suppliers must be UK registered, have a physical business address, at least 12 months trading history, and a sustained average public review score of 4.0 stars or higher.
We monitor complaints and public reviews. If a supplier repeatedly breaches our terms or their rating falls below 3.5 stars, we remove them from our network.

blocks.text: Important: Once a supplier receives your data, they become an independent data controller for that data. Their use of your data is governed by their own privacy policy. We do not control how they use your data after that point, but we require them contractually to comply with UK data protection law. We strongly recommend you read the supplier's privacy policy before engaging their services.

rows: To store and serve our website
To manage leads and supplier interactions
Name, email, phone, vehicle details, enquiry notes
To send you quote confirmations and follow-up emails
Pseudonymised IP address, browser data, page views
To retrieve vehicle details from your registration

blocks.text: 5.3 Sharing for legal or regulatory reasons

We may disclose your personal data if required by law, court order, or a government authority (e.g., HMRC, police, ICO). We may also disclose data to enforce our terms and conditions, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of our business, our users, or others.
In any other situation, we will ask for your explicit consent before sharing your data.

items.title: International data transfers
items.description: Your personal data is primarily stored and processed within the United Kingdom.

blocks.text: Some of our service providers (e.g., cloud hosting, analytics) may operate servers outside the UK — typically in the European Economic Area (EEA) or other countries with adequate data protection laws.
When we transfer your data outside the UK, we ensure an equivalent level of protection by using:

items: The UK International Data Transfer Addendum (IDTA) — the UK's replacement for the EU SCCs
Transfers to countries with UK adequacy decisions (e.g., the EEA, Japan, South Korea)

blocks.text: We do not transfer your data to countries without adequate protections unless we have your explicit consent or it is necessary for the performance of a contract.
If you want more information about our transfer mechanisms, please contact dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk .

items.title: Cookies and tracking technologies
items.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to:

items: Ensure our Platform works properly (strictly necessary cookies)
Analyse how users interact with our Platform (performance/analytics cookies)
Remember your preferences (functional cookies)

blocks.text: We do not use targeting/advertising cookies that track you across other websites.
For full details, including how to manage your cookie preferences, please read our separate Cookie Policy .

items.title: Your data, your control
items.description: To help you quickly understand your rights and our practices, here is a plain-English summary:

blocks.question: Do you sell my data?
blocks.answer: No. Never. We do not sell your personal data to any third party.

blocks.question: Do you send marketing emails?
blocks.answer: No. We only send service-related emails (quote confirmations, follow-ups). We do not send any marketing emails.

blocks.question: Who sees my data?
blocks.answer: Up to 10 vetted UK engine suppliers (maximum) plus our trusted service providers (hosting, CRM, email, analytics).

blocks.question: How long do you keep my data?
blocks.answer: 6 months from your last interaction, then automatically deleted.

blocks.question: Can I delete my data earlier?
blocks.answer: Yes, free of charge. Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk and we will delete your data within 30 days.

blocks.question: Do you use my data for AI training?
blocks.answer: No. We do not use your personal data for training AI models.

blocks.question: What if an AI image looks like my work?
blocks.answer: Email copyrights@enginesmarket.co.uk — we will investigate and remove if necessary.

blocks.question: Do I have to accept all cookies?
blocks.answer: No. You can reject non-essential cookies via our banner. Only strictly necessary cookies are placed automatically.

blocks.text: Version history: June 2026 — Version 2.0: Complete rewrite to reflect UK GDPR, add image copyright section, clarify supplier cap and data sharing safeguards, extend retention to 6 months, and increase length to 4000+ words.
This Privacy Policy was last reviewed and approved by the Data Protection Officer of PRESTIGE AUTO ENGINEERING LTD on 13 June 2026.
Have questions about your data or this policy? Contact our Data Protection Officer.

items.title: Compare quotes from vetted UK suppliers
items.description: Submit your engine replacement enquiry and receive up to 4 quotes from specialists who meet our strict standards.

items.title: Data security — how we protect you

rows: Data is encrypted at rest (on our servers) and in transit (using TLS 1.3/1.2 across our website).
Only authorised employees and our data processors have access to personal data, and only for legitimate purposes.
We limit the number of suppliers who can access your lead to a maximum of 10, reducing exposure.
Suppliers sign binding Data Sharing Agreements that require them to protect your data and indemnify us against breaches.
We perform vulnerability scans and penetration tests (at least annually) to identify and fix security weaknesses.
All employees receive annual data protection and security awareness training.

blocks.text: However, no method of transmission over the internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. By using our Platform, you acknowledge this inherent risk.
If we become aware of a data breach that is likely to result in a risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you and the ICO within 72 hours, as required by UK GDPR.

items.title: Data retention — how long we keep your data
items.description: We keep your personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes described in this policy.

rows: To allow you to follow up on quotes, and for us to improve our service. After 6 months, data is automatically deleted from our active systems.
For analytics, market research, and improving our Platform.
To maintain network quality and defend against legal claims.
6 months from the date of the communication
For training, quality control, and resolving disputes.

blocks.text: After the retention period expires, your data is automatically and permanently deleted from our active databases. It may remain in encrypted backups for a short additional period (up to 30 days) before being deleted.

Early erasure: You have the right to request erasure before the 6-month period ends. There is no fee for early erasure. We will delete your data within 30 days of your verified request to dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk .

items.title: Your rights under UK GDPR
items.description: You have the following rights regarding your personal data. They are free to exercise (except in limited circumstances).

rows: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk with “SAR” in the subject line. We will respond within one month.
If your data is inaccurate or incomplete, you can ask us to correct it.
Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk with the correct information.
You can ask us to delete your personal data. This is not absolute (e.g., we may need to retain data for legal reasons).
Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk . We will delete your data within one month, unless a legal exception applies. There is no fee for erasure requests.
You can ask us to temporarily stop processing your data (e.g., while a dispute is resolved).
Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk explaining why you want restriction.
You can request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format (e.g., CSV) to transfer to another service.
Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk . We will provide your data within one month.
You can object to processing based on legitimate interests (e.g., analytics, service improvement).
Email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk . We will stop processing unless we have compelling legitimate grounds to continue.
If we ever rely on consent (e.g., for marketing or non-essential cookies), you can withdraw it at any time.
Adjust your cookie preferences via our banner or email dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk .

blocks.text: To exercise any right, please contact: dpo@enginesmarket.co.uk

We may need to verify your identity before processing your request. We will respond within one calendar month (30 days). If your request is complex or you have made multiple requests, we may extend the response time by a further two months — we will inform you within the first month.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) if you are unhappy with how we have handled your data. See Section 14 for contact details.

items.title: Image copyright — our commitment to intellectual property rights
items.description: Our Platform displays thousands of images of engines, vehicles, components, and related automotive content. We are committed to respecting intellectual property rights and complying with UK copyright law ( Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988 ).

rows: Images we have taken ourselves (e.g., of reconditioning processes, workshops).
© Engines Market / PRESTIGE AUTO ENGINEERING LTD. All rights reserved.
Images supplied to us by our network of engine specialists.
We hold a perpetual, royalty-free licence from each supplier to use these images on our Platform. The supplier warrants that they have the right to provide the image.
Images created using artificial intelligence tools (e.g., DALL-E, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion).

These images are original works generated by AI at our direction. No human creator was directly involved. However, we acknowledge that AI-generated images may unintentionally resemble existing copyrighted works due to the nature of AI training data.

blocks.text: We use AI-generated images for purposes such as illustrating engine types, vehicle models, failure examples, and generic workshop scenes. These images are not direct copies of any third-party photograph or illustration. Nevertheless, because AI models are trained on vast datasets, there is a small possibility that an AI-generated image may bear a resemblance to an existing copyrighted work.
If you believe an AI-generated image on our Platform infringes your copyright, please contact us using the process below. We take such claims seriously and will investigate promptly.
If you believe that any image on our Platform infringes your copyright (whether the image was AI-generated, provided by a supplier, or otherwise), please send a copyright infringement notice to:

items: Your full name and contact information (email address and postal address).
A clear identification of the copyrighted work you claim has been infringed (e.g., a description and, if possible, a URL or copy of the original work).
The specific URL(s) on our Platform where the allegedly infringing image appears.
A statement that you have a good faith belief that the use of the image is not authorised by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
A statement, made under penalty of perjury, that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorised to act on their behalf.
Your electronic or physical signature.

blocks.text: We will acknowledge receipt of your notice within 5 working days and will investigate within 14 days. If we determine that the image infringes your copyright, we will:

items: Immediately remove or disable access to the image.
Notify the supplier (if the image was sourced from a supplier) or, for AI-generated images, adjust our generation prompts to avoid similar outputs in the future.

blocks.text: We will also keep a record of all copyright complaints for compliance and auditing purposes.
Engines Market has a policy of terminating, in appropriate circumstances, the accounts of suppliers or users who are repeat infringers of intellectual property rights.

items.title: Changes to this Privacy Policy
items.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or the services we offer.

items: Minor changes (e.g., clarification of wording, correction of typos) will be posted on this page with a new “Last updated” date.

Material changes (e.g., new data sharing practices, changes to retention periods, new lawful bases) will be notified to you by email (if you have provided your email address) and via a prominent notice on our Platform at least 30 days before they take effect.

blocks.text: We encourage you to review this policy periodically. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page indicates when the policy was last revised.

items.title: Governing law
items.description: This Privacy Policy is governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes arising under or in connection with this policy shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

items.title: Right to complain to the ICO
items.description: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) , the UK supervisory authority for data protection issues, at any time. We would appreciate the opportunity to resolve your concerns first, so please contact us before approaching the ICO.

blocks.text: Website: https://ico.org.uk Phone: 0303 123 1113 Post: Information Commissioner's Office, Wycliffe House, Water Lane, Wilmslow, Cheshire SK9 5AF

items.title: Contact us
items.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, your data rights, or if you wish to make a complaint about our handling of your personal data, please contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO):

rows: Data Protection Officer, PRESTIGE AUTO ENGINEERING LTD, Unit A5 Windsor Road Commercial Estate, Ramsden Heath, Billericay, United Kingdom, CM11 1QE

blocks.text: We aim to respond to all data protection enquiries within 5 working days and resolve complaints within 30 days.
